PassiveDesc: No major weakness. Smooth progression in both combat and shopping.
Excels at close combat and benefits more from melee-focused builds.
Ranged weapons scale better and moving while fighting is safer.
Arcane and energy-style weapons gain extra value on this character.
Higher durability and max health, but lower overall tempo.
Generates stronger economy through luck, drops, and scaling resources.
High movement and dodge make kiting and spacing easier.
Summons and device-oriented weapons gain extra value.
Critical and chase-based builds are stronger on consecutive kills.
Healing and defensive items are more efficient on this character.
Very aggressive melee scaling with weaker defensive stability.
High dodge and luck support evasive, slippery play patterns.
